name: Biochemistry
summary: The chemistry of living systems from the biology side: protein structure, enzyme kinetics, biomolecules and the energetics that drive metabolism.

topics.name: Amino acids, peptide bonds and protein structure hierarchy
Protein function: myoglobin, hemoglobin, oxygen binding and cooperativity
Enzyme kinetics: Michaelis-Menten, Lineweaver-Burk and inhibition
Enzyme regulation: allostery, covalent modification and zymogens
Bioenergetics: free energy, coupled reactions, ATP and redox potentials
Overview of metabolism: catabolism, anabolism and metabolic maps
